sites.name: Shackelford County Campus (Vantage "Frontier", Stargate)
sites.region: Texas (Shackelford County, near TX-351 southwest of Albany)
sites.grid_operator: Off-grid — behind-the-meter gas microgrid (VoltaGrid, Jenbacher reciprocating engines); ERCOT region
sites.cooling: closed-loop chiller; combined air-cooled + liquid-to-liquid, 250kW+ racks (one-time fill, non-evaporative)
sites.summary_ko: Vantage Data Centers 가 1,200에이커에 짓는 10개 동·370만 sq ft·IT 1.4GW 캠퍼스('Frontier', 투자 $25bn 이상). Oracle 이 2025-08 계약해 임차·운영하고 OpenAI Stargate 용량으로 쓴다. 전력은 VoltaGrid 가 운영하는 현장 가스 마이크로그리드(계통 비연결). 2025-12 공식 착공, 첫 동은 Vantage 기준 2026 하반기 인도, Oracle 기준 고객 인도는 2027 상반기 시작. 2026-06 기준 115MW 전력 가동(일정보다 1개월 이상 앞섬).
sites.summary_en: Vantage Data Centers' 'Frontier' campus: 10 buildings, 3.7M sq ft, 1.4GW of critical IT on 1,200 acres ($25bn+). Oracle contracted it in Aug 2025 to lease and operate as OpenAI Stargate capacity. Powered by an off-grid, behind-the-meter gas microgrid run by VoltaGrid. Official groundbreaking Dec 2025; Vantage targets first building delivery in H2 2026, Oracle says customer delivery begins H1 2027. 115MW of power was online by Jun 2026, over a month ahead of schedule.

deliveries.what: Behind-the-meter gas microgrid (VoltaGrid modular Jenbacher engines; part of Oracle–VoltaGrid 2.3GW Texas deal)

timeline.event: Vantage, 1.4GW·$25bn 'Frontier' 캠퍼스 발표 (Oracle 2025-08 계약)
timeline.event_en: Vantage unveils the 1.4GW, $25bn 'Frontier' campus (Oracle contracted Aug 2025)

timeline.event: OpenAI·Oracle, Stargate 신규 부지로 공식 발표. 이미 공사 시작
timeline.event_en: Announced by OpenAI and Oracle as a new Stargate site; construction already under way

timeline.event: Oracle–VoltaGrid 텍사스 AI 데이터센터용 2.3GW 가스 발전 계약
timeline.event_en: Oracle–VoltaGrid deal for 2.3GW of gas generation for Texas AI data centers

timeline.event: 공식 착공식
timeline.event_en: Official groundbreaking ceremony

timeline.event: Oracle: 115MW 전력 가동(일정보다 1개월 이상 앞섬), 고객 인도는 2027 상반기 시작
timeline.event_en: Oracle: 115MW of power online (1+ month early); customer delivery begins H1 2027

timeline.event: Oracle: '다음 기가와트급 캠퍼스, 순조롭게 진행'. FY27 1분기(~8월)까지 인도분 없음
timeline.event_en: Oracle: 'next gigawatt-scale campus, progressing well'; nothing delivered through Q1 FY27 (Aug)

estimates.note_en: Firm = 115MW energized (Jun 2026); 1,820MW (1.4GW IT × 1.3) is the announced scale

estimates.note: secured_mw 1,820MW 는 Vantage 의 IT 1.4GW × PUE 1.3 으로 환산한 추정치. 현장 마이크로그리드의 실제 확보 규모는 미공개(Cleanview 가 인용한 TCEQ 대기 인허가는 최대 약 2.58GW, Oracle–VoltaGrid 계약은 텍사스 전체 2.3GW). 2026-06 energized 115MW 는 Oracle 발표값.
estimates.note_en: secured_mw 1,820MW is Vantage's 1.4GW IT × PUE 1.3. Actual on-site microgrid capacity undisclosed (TCEQ air permit cited by Cleanview allows up to ~2.58GW; Oracle–VoltaGrid deal is 2.3GW across Texas). 2026-06 energized 115MW is Oracle's figure.

estimates.note: 동별 IT MW(140MW)는 1.4GW/10개 동 균등 배분 추정. 2~10동 착공·가동 시점은 Epoch AI 위성 분석(Tier 3: 2026-01 1~5동 철골, 2026-09 1~5동 외장 완료, 2027-08~2028-11 순차 가동)을 근사. 진행률(1동 0.8, 2~5동 0.5)도 같은 분석과 'Vantage 2026 하반기 첫 동 인도' 목표로 근사.
estimates.note_en: Per-building IT (140MW) assumes 1.4GW split evenly across 10 buildings. Timing for buildings 2–10 approximates Epoch AI satellite analysis (Tier 3: steel on B1–5 Jan 2026, shells roofed Sep 2026, sequential operation Aug 2027–Nov 2028). Progress (B1 0.8, B2–5 0.5) approximated from the same analysis and Vantage's H2 2026 first-building target.

estimates.note: 좌표는 지역 보도('Albany 남서쪽, TX-351·FM 604 부근, Hamby 쪽 서부')를 근거로 한 대략 위치(low). 공식 주소·필지 미확인.
estimates.note_en: Coordinates are approximate (low), based on local reports placing the site southwest of Albany near TX-351/FM 604 in the county's west. No official address/parcel confirmed.

sites.name: Saline Township Campus (Related Digital "The Barn", Stargate Michigan)
sites.name_ko: 세일린 타운십 캠퍼스 (Related Digital 'The Barn', Stargate 미시간)
sites.region: Michigan (Washtenaw County, Saline Township — north of Michigan Ave)
sites.grid_operator: DTE Electric (MISO) — special contracts, MPSC case U-21990
sites.summary_ko: Related Digital 이 Oracle 전용으로 짓는 3개 동(각 55만 sq ft, 단층) 캠퍼스. 1,000에이커 이상 부지 중 250에이커 사용. DTE 특별계약(Oracle 자회사 Green Chile Ventures, 1,383MW, 19년)을 2025-12 MPSC 가 조건부 승인했고 1.4GW 배터리 저장도 프로젝트가 부담한다. 2026-06-01 착공식, 자금은 Related·Blackstone 지분과 PIMCO 주도 장기 부채($16bn). Oracle 기준 고객 인도는 2027 하반기 시작, 네트워크 코어는 2026년 말 인도.
sites.summary_en: Three single-story 550k sq ft buildings developed by Related Digital exclusively for Oracle, using 250 of 1,000+ acres. MPSC conditionally approved DTE special contracts (Oracle subsidiary Green Chile Ventures, 1,383MW, 19 years) in Dec 2025, with ~1.4GW of battery storage funded by the project. Groundbreaking celebrated Jun 1, 2026; financed by Related and Blackstone equity plus PIMCO-anchored long-term debt (~$16bn). Oracle says customer delivery begins H2 2027; network core by end-2026.

deliveries.what: Battery energy storage (~1.4GW, DTE-owned, funded by Green Chile Ventures) + new onsite substation

timeline.event: 타운십·Related Digital 소송 합의(동의 판결)로 재조닝 허용
timeline.event_en: Consent judgment settles rezoning lawsuit, allowing the project

timeline.event: OpenAI·Oracle·Related Digital, 1GW 초과 Stargate 미시간 캠퍼스 발표
timeline.event_en: OpenAI, Oracle and Related Digital announce 1GW+ Stargate Michigan campus

timeline.event: MPSC, DTE 특별계약(1,383MW, Green Chile Ventures) 조건부 승인
timeline.event_en: MPSC conditionally approves DTE special contracts (1,383MW, Green Chile Ventures)

timeline.event: 착공 기념식(주지사 참석). Related·Blackstone 지분 + PIMCO 주도 부채로 자금 조달
timeline.event_en: Construction celebration with the governor; financed by Related and Blackstone equity plus PIMCO-anchored debt

timeline.event: Oracle: 고객 인도 2027 하반기 시작, 네트워크 코어 2026년 말 인도
timeline.event_en: Oracle: customer delivery begins H2 2027; network core by end-2026

timeline.event: 주 법무장관, MPSC 승인에 대한 항소 서면 제출(진행 중)
timeline.event_en: State AG files appeal brief challenging the MPSC approval (pending)

timeline.event: 누적 노조 작업 100만 시간, 현장 인력 2,000명 이상
timeline.event_en: One million union craft hours; 2,000+ tradespeople on site

estimates.note: 동별 MW 461MW 는 DTE 계약 1,383MW(계통 기준)를 3개 동에 균등 배분한 추정. IT MW 미공개.
estimates.note_en: 461MW per building splits the 1,383MW DTE contract (grid basis) evenly across three buildings; IT MW undisclosed.

estimates.note: Compute 1 착공 2026-02 는 'Q1 2026 본격 착공 예정'(Oracle 2025-12 블로그)과 2026-05 무렵 누적 20만 시간 보도를 근거로 한 추정. 시운전 2027-Q2 는 'H2 2027 고객 인도'에서 역산. 진행률 0.5 는 착공 8개월·100만 시간·'Compute 1' 작업 언급으로 근사.
estimates.note_en: Compute 1 start (2026-02) is inferred from Oracle's 'full construction in Q1 2026' plan and ~200k hours by ~May 2026; commissioning 2027-Q2 back-calculated from H2 2027 customer delivery; progress 0.5 approximated from 8 months of work and 1M craft hours.

estimates.note: Compute 2·3 착공·가동 시점은 미공개라 추정(2동 2026 하반기 착공·2028 상반기 가동, 3동 2027-Q1 착공·2029 가동). DBusiness 는 캠퍼스 완공(개장)을 2029 로 보도.
estimates.note_en: Compute 2/3 timing undisclosed, estimated (B2 start H2 2026, operate H1 2028; B3 start Q1 2027, operate 2029). DBusiness reports full campus opening in 2029.

sites.name: Port Washington Campus (Vantage "Lighthouse", Stargate Wisconsin)
sites.region: Wisconsin (Ozaukee County, Port Washington — north of the city, ~30 min from Milwaukee)
sites.grid_operator: We Energies (MISO) — VLC tariff; ATC Ozaukee County Distribution Interconnection Project (pending)
sites.summary_ko: Vantage 가 672에이커(건물 500에이커)에 짓는 4개 동·250만 sq ft·IT 902MW 캠퍼스('Lighthouse', $15bn). 2025-10 발표된 Stargate '중서부 부지'로 Oracle 이 임차·운영한다. 2025-12 착공, Vantage 완공 목표 2028, Oracle 기준 고객 인도는 2027 하반기 시작. 1단계 계통 수요 1.3GW(장기 최대 3.5GW)를 We Energies 가 공급하나, 이를 위한 ATC 송전·변전 사업($2.5~2.7bn)은 2026-08 PSC 가 신청 완결성 결정을 취소해 2026-09 재신청한 상태.
sites.summary_en: Vantage's 'Lighthouse' campus: 4 buildings, 2.5M sq ft, 902MW critical IT on 672 acres (500 developed), $15bn. The Stargate 'Midwest site' announced Oct 2025, leased and operated by Oracle. Construction began Dec 2025; Vantage targets completion in 2028, Oracle says customer delivery begins H2 2027. We Energies is to serve ~1.3GW in phase 1 (up to 3.5GW long term), but the PSC revoked completeness of ATC's $2.5–2.7bn interconnection project in Aug 2026; ATC refiled in Sep 2026.

deliveries.what: ATC Ozaukee County Distribution Interconnection Project (new/rebuilt HV lines, up to 5 substations; $2.48–2.72bn) — refiled after PSC revoked completeness
deliveries.eta: previously targeted end-2027; new schedule pending PSC review

timeline.event: OpenAI·Oracle·Vantage, Port Washington Stargate 캠퍼스('중서부 부지') 발표. 4개 동·약 1GW, 2028 완공 목표
timeline.event_en: OpenAI, Oracle and Vantage announce the Port Washington Stargate campus (the 'Midwest site'): 4 buildings, ~1GW, completion 2028

timeline.event: 착공(1단계 $8bn)
timeline.event_en: Construction begins (phase 1, $8bn)

timeline.event: PSC, We Energies 대형 고객(VLC) 요금제 승인
timeline.event_en: PSC approves We Energies' Very Large Customer (VLC) tariff

timeline.event: Oracle: 2025-09 계약, 고객 인도 2027 하반기 시작
timeline.event_en: Oracle: contracted Sep 2025; customer delivery begins H2 2027

timeline.event: PSC, ATC 송전 사업 신청의 '완결성' 결정 취소 → 재신청 필요
timeline.event_en: PSC revokes completeness of ATC's interconnection application, forcing a refiling

timeline.event: ATC 재신청($2.48~2.72bn), Oracle '완공 의지 변함없음'
timeline.event_en: ATC refiles ($2.48–2.72bn); Oracle says commitment unchanged

estimates.note: secured_mw 1,300MW 는 We Energies 계획상 1단계 수요(CUB 인용, WPR)로 basis target. ATC 송전 사업 미승인이라 실제 '확보'는 아님. Vantage IT 902MW × 1.3 ≈ 1,173MW 와도 대체로 맞음. 2028 전량 통전은 Vantage 완공 목표를 그대로 옮긴 것.
estimates.note_en: secured_mw 1,300MW is We Energies' planned phase-1 demand (per CUB via WPR), basis target; not truly secured while ATC's project is unapproved. Roughly consistent with 902MW IT × 1.3 ≈ 1,173MW. Full energization in 2028 mirrors Vantage's completion target.

sites.name: Doña Ana County Campus (Project Jupiter, Stargate New Mexico)
sites.name_ko: 도냐아나 카운티 캠퍼스 (Project Jupiter, Stargate 뉴멕시코)
sites.region: New Mexico (Doña Ana County, Santa Teresa — near El Paso / US–Mexico border)
sites.grid_operator: Off-grid — behind-the-meter Bloom fuel-cell microgrid (up to 2.45GW installed); small utility substation only for office/commissioning
sites.summary_ko: BorderPlex Digital Assets·STACK Infrastructure(Blue Owl 계열)가 Santa Teresa 에 짓는 4개 동+창고 캠퍼스로 Oracle 이 임차·운영(OpenAI 용). 2026-04 전력 설계를 가스터빈에서 Bloom 연료전지(최대 2.45GW 설치, 계통 비연결)로 바꿨다. 데이터센터 건물은 카운티 허가로 건설 중이나, 마이크로그리드 대기 인허가 절차는 주 대법원이 중지했고 가스 공급 파이프라인은 2027-02-01 로 약 6개월 지연. Oracle 은 2026-09-24 개발사에 불가항력 통지를 보냈다(2028 가동 목표 미달 시 지급 유예 목적, 임차 철회 아님).
sites.summary_en: Four buildings plus a warehouse in Santa Teresa developed by BorderPlex Digital Assets and STACK Infrastructure (Blue Owl), leased and operated by Oracle for OpenAI. In Apr 2026 the power design switched from gas turbines to an off-grid Bloom fuel-cell microgrid (up to 2.45GW installed). Data center buildings are rising under county permits, but the microgrid air-permit proceeding was stayed by the state Supreme Court and the gas pipeline slipped ~6 months to Feb 1, 2027. On Sep 24, 2026 Oracle sent the developer a force majeure notice (to defer payments if the 2028 target is missed; not an exit).

deliveries.what: Bloom Energy solid-oxide fuel cells (up to 2.45GW installed microgrid, operated by Yucca Growth Infrastructure)
Natural gas lateral pipeline to the microgrid

timeline.event: Stargate 신규 부지로 발표. 카운티가 산업수익채권(IRB, 최대 $165bn) 승인
timeline.event_en: Announced as a Stargate site; county approves industrial revenue bonds (up to $165bn)

timeline.event: Oracle, 임차인으로서 완공 후 입주·OpenAI 용 AI 인프라 배치 확인
timeline.event_en: Oracle confirms it is the tenant and will deploy AI infrastructure for OpenAI after completion

timeline.event: 전력 설계 변경: 가스터빈·디젤 → Bloom 연료전지 최대 2.45GW 단일 마이크로그리드
timeline.event_en: Power redesign: gas turbines/diesel replaced by up to 2.45GW Bloom fuel-cell microgrid

timeline.event: Oracle: 2025-09 계약, 고객 인도 2027 상반기 시작 예정
timeline.event_en: Oracle: contracted Sep 2025; customer delivery to begin H1 2027

timeline.event: Oracle 성명: 주 대법원이 마이크로그리드 대기 인허가 절차 중지, 건물 공사는 카운티 허가로 계속
timeline.event_en: Oracle statement: state Supreme Court stayed the microgrid air-permit proceeding; building construction continues under county permits

timeline.event: Oracle, 개발사(Blue Owl 계열 STACK)에 불가항력 통지 — 2028 가동 지연 시 지급 유예 권리 확보
timeline.event_en: Oracle sends a force majeure notice to developer (Blue Owl's STACK) to defer payments if 2028 opening slips

timeline.event: 홍수가 현장에 도달했으나 핵심 설비 피해 없음, '계획된 일정 유지'
timeline.event_en: Floods reached the campus; no critical infrastructure damaged, 'remains on planned schedule'

estimates.note: secured_mw 1,000MW 는 Oracle CEO 의 '이 부지들은 대략 1GW 씩'(2026-09) 발언을 따른 낮은 값(target). 연료전지 설치 용량은 최대 2.45GW 지만 Oracle 은 중복 여유분이라 '전부 필요하지 않다'고 밝힘. Epoch AI(Tier 3)는 2028 말 IT 1,750MW 를 추정 → 확인되면 상향.
estimates.note_en: secured_mw 1,000MW follows the Oracle CEO's 'around a gigawatt a piece' (Sep 2026), the lower value (target). Installed fuel cells are up to 2.45GW, but Oracle says the project 'doesn't need all of it' (redundancy). Epoch AI (Tier 3) projects 1,750MW IT by end-2028 — raise if confirmed.

estimates.note: 좌표는 Santa Teresa 도시 중심. 보도상 캠퍼스는 Santa Teresa 남쪽 약 3.6마일로 핀과 수 km 차이.
estimates.note_en: Coordinates are the Santa Teresa town centroid; reports place the campus ~3.6 miles south, a few km from the pin.
